programs.title: Odd Squad
programs.sub_title: The Triangle Cafe; Captain O's Birthday
programs.desc: Ozzi and Orli go on a mission to catch the villain who is ruining the Triangle Sisters' café; Opie must collect enough money to pay for Captain O's 10-layer birthday cake.

programs.title: The Making of the American Revolution
programs.desc: A behind the scenes look at "The American Revolution" with Ken Burns, Sarah Botstein and David Schmidt to learn about the production, which took nearly a decade to complete.

programs.title: Rick Steves Fascism in Europe
programs.desc: Rick Steves traces fascism's history in Europe. Our goal: to learn from the hard lessons of the 20th century, and to recognize that ideology in the 21st century.

programs.title: Rick Steves Experiencing Europe
programs.desc: Rick Steves presents essential skills for smart travel in Europe, from itinerary planning to avoiding crowds.

programs.title: Rick Steves Art of Europe: Michelangelo to Monet
programs.desc: Celebrating Europe's art and creative geniuses, from Leonardo Da Vinci to Vincent van Gogh; Florence's bold "rebirth" after Europe's medieval struggles; impressionist works of the late 1800s.

programs.title: 60s and 70s Soul Celebration (My Music Presents)
programs.desc: Legends of 1960s and 1970s soul music perform their biggest hits; acts include The Temptations, James Brown, Patti LaBelle, The Chi-Lites, The Spinners, Sam Moore and more.
